content.stem: 一家金融机构收到了有关在要求提供额外信息时客户在开户流程中遭遇阻碍的投诉.哪些潜在的解决方案有助于确保客户注册体验更顺畅、减少阻碍？(选择两项.)

options.A: 实施内部或外部工具以简化客户开户流程
options.B: 每三年才实施一次新流程,以确保一致性
options.C: 确保对所有员工进行新流程、新政策和新工具的持续培训
options.D: 确保只有团队负责人或经理拥有决策权

content.stem_en: A financial institution has received complaints about friction in the onboarding process when additional information is requested. Which potential solutions could help ensure a better customer onboarding experience with reduced friction? (Select two.)

options_en.A: Implement internal or external tools that streamline onboarding processes
options_en.B: Implement new processes only once every three years to ensure consistency
options_en.C: Ensure consistent training of all employees on new processes, policies, and tools
options_en.D: Ensure that only team leads or managers have decision-making power
